title: docs(spec): kanban.lanes TSDoc states what the board draws; checkKanbanLanes docblock names its option map
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao1SJdy8FRAJZyYtYYDAwKHH)_

Fixes #28319

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`kanban.lanes` 的 TSDoc 去掉「看板暂不读这个键」那段过时说明,改成如实描述:只画列出的泳道、按作者写的顺序,未列出的值落进 `Uncategorized`,不写该键则每个选项一条泳道;lint 的 `checkKanbanLanes` 注释补一句:将来若扩展 `groupByField` 可带的内联选项,必须并入它读的选项表。
- 为什么改:#28291 合入后看板已经按 `kanban.lanes` 画泳道,旧说明会让读参考文档的作者(包括 AI)以为这个键没用而不去用它;写错一句给 AI 看的文档等于产品缺陷。
- 风险与回滚:只改注释文字,不改 schema、不改行为;生成产物无变化(`check:generated` 全绿)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` 中 `lanes` 的 TSDoc 末段;`packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` 中 `checkKanbanLanes` 的注释;`.changeset/28319-kanban-lanes-tsdoc.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "Lands ahead of its reader: the board draws one lane" origin/main -- packages/spec` 在 main 上有一处命中,本分支零命中。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(TSDoc 属于 spec 源码,先走契约复审)。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: the last paragraph of the `KanbanConfigSchema.lanes` TSDoc said the board drew one lane per option until the Console read the key. It now says what the board draws: the listed lanes and no others, in the order the author wrote them; a record whose value is not listed lands in `Uncategorized`; without the key, one lane per option in the options' own order. The `.describe()` text was checked and already says this (no "ahead of its reader" clause), so it is unchanged.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`: the `checkKanbanLanes` docblock gains the line review rider S2 asked for: the rule reads only the option map built from inline `options[].value`, and a future `FieldSchema` key that widens the inline options a `groupByField` may carry must join that map, or a lane naming a widened option is reported as unknown.
- `.changeset/28319-kanban-lanes-tsdoc.md`: a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`, because the TSDoc ships in the package (`dist` chunks and `src/**/*.zod.ts` are in its `files`). `@objectstack/lint` gets no changeset entry: its built `dist` carries none of the edited docblock (measured below).

No schema, type, export or behaviour change.

## Why

Since #28291 the board draws only the declared `kanban.lanes`, in order. The TSDoc still told authors, and agents reading the spec source, that the board ignores the key, so an author would not use a live key.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 171 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run typecheck`: exit 0.

## Verification

Local gates at head `fb157ea7` (the last commit; nothing pushed after).

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 74 derived, 73 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 74 commands against the diff (2 source files + the changeset). Each ran with stdin closed and its exit code recorded before any pipe.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran` reconciles: "74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (prerequisite: it needs every package's `dist`, a whole-workspace build; this diff changes comments only). CI runs it.
- First attempts that exited 3 and were re-run green after their prerequisite was met: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (after fetching its pinned fixture commit) and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` (after building `@objectstack/objectql`).
- Doc-authoring gates named by the order: `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:issue-citations`, `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, `pnpm check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`: all exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Generated artefacts and the order's per-card gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0, every artefact up to date (including `check:docs` over `content/docs/references/**` and `check:authorable-surface` over the JSON schemas). The TSDoc does not reach a generated reference, so nothing was regenerated.
- `git grep` for the old sentence across the tree (including `content/docs`) found it only in `view.zod.ts`.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Changeset measurement (which package ships the edited text)</summary>

- After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, the new TSDoc sentence is in `packages/spec/dist/chunk-*.mjs` and `chunk-*.js`, and the old one is in no `dist` file; `src/**/*.zod.ts` also ships. So `@objectstack/spec` publishes it: `patch`.
- After building `@objectstack/lint`, neither the new docblock line nor the neighbouring existing docblock sentence is in `packages/lint/dist`, while a message string from the same function is (positive control: `is not an option of` in `dist/runtime.js` and `dist/index.cjs`). So lint publishes nothing new.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The order also asked to check `.describe()` for the stale clause: it never carried one, so it is unchanged.
- Rider S2 asked for "a note on the module docblock"; the card and the order place it on the `checkKanbanLanes` docblock, which is where it went. The module's `kanban.lanes` section is unchanged.
- A contract review is owed (the TSDoc is spec source); the seat routes it.
